patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Clay share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

BookYourData and Clay share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than Clay's shape. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans email-outreach; Clay leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Clay share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BookYourData is Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go credits and a 97% deliverability guarantee.; Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris.
- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning email-outreach vs Clay-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model.
